title: A protocol for imaging spindle orientation and inheritance of fate determinants in real time.
protocol: Isolate and sort bone marrow derived hematopoietic stem cells (c-kit+ Lin- Sca-1+; KLS) from adult mice.
Culture sorted cells overnight (~16 hrs) in X-Vivo™15 media supplemented with 2-mercaptoethanol, fetal bovine serum, SCF, and thrombopoietin.
Infect cells with retroviruses: Numb:CFP and mCherry-α-tubulin.
Harvest cells 48 hours after infection and re-sort for CFP+ mCherry+ cells.
Dissolve 4-OH tamoxifen in ethanol to prepare a 1000X stock solution.
Prepare a 1X solution of 4-OH tamoxifen immediately before treatment.
Plate sorted cells in Iscove’s modified medium-based methylcellulose medium supplemented with 4-OH tamoxifen.
Maintain cultures at 37°C, 5% CO2 using an Axio Observer.Z1 microscope with the LSM 700 scanning module.
Collect images every 3-4 minutes with xyzt acquisition mode.
Isolate and sort bone marrow derived hematopoietic stem cell (HSC)-enriched cells (c-kit+ Lin- Sca-1+; KLS) from adult mice.
Identify dividing cells in movie replay.
Visualize cells in spectrum color format to readily identify the centrosomes.
Draw a line connecting the two centrosomes of a cell using ImageJ software.
Subsequently, draw an additional line perpendicular to Line 1 to mark the cleavage furrow and partition the mother cell into incipient daughter cell 1 (D1) and daughter cell 2 (D2).
Determine fluorescence intensity of Numb for D1 and D2 using ImageJ software.
Culture cells overnight for approximately 16 hours in X-Vivo™15 media supplemented with 50 μM 2-mercaptoethanol, 10% fetal bovine serum, SCF at 100 ng/ml, and thrombopoietin at 20 ng/ml.
Infect cells with retroviruses MSCV-H2B-GFP and mCherry-α-tubulin.
Harvest cells 48 hours after infection and re-sort for GFP+ mCherry+ KLS cells.
Culture cells in 96-well U-bottomed plates for 48 hours with 4-OH tamoxifen.
Dissolve 4-OH tamoxifen in ethanol at a concentration of 1 mg/ml to create a 1000X stock solution.
Prepare a 1X solution of 4-OH tamoxifen immediately before treatment.
Place cells on chambered coverglass slides coated with 0.1 μg/μl Retronectin® in the presence of 4-OH tamoxifen.
Collect images every 3-4 minutes using an Axio Observer.Z1 microscope with the LSM 700 scanning module in xyzt acquisition mode.
Maintain cultures at 37°C and 5% CO2 during imaging.
Identify mitotic cells by reviewing movie replay.
Generate a concatenation of Z-stack images for each cell from metaphase to early telophase.
Display all images in orthogonally view using Zen 2010 software to measure spindle angle.
Using ImageJ software, measure the angle formed between the substratum plane (Retronectin base) and the virtual line passing through spindle poles.
